title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey fined DataOne $1.07 million after state inspectors found 62 natural gas generators at its Vineland data center site in late July. None of the 2,000 kilowatt generators had permits to be installed or operated. The state said the fine, issued Tuesday, was for violating the Air Pollution Control Act and was the largest ever given to a New Jersey data center operator.

The Vineland campus is under construction and is planned to be 2.6 million square feet, requiring 350 megawatts of power, with completion set for the end of the year. Some of it is already in use. Homeowners have filed a federal lawsuit over persistent noise, and the Cumberland County Health Department has issued violation orders to DataOne for excessive noise. No next steps were reported.
